tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture an app's accessibility tree as JSON, with a ref for each element you can act on.

interactive_only.description: Only the elements you can act on.

skeleton.description: A shallow map, with children_count on cut branches.

root.description: Start from this ref's subtree instead of the window.

wait_for.description: Poll until an element matching role:text appears.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Search an app's elements by role, name, value or text.

role.description: An accessibility role: button, textfield, checkbox...

text.description: Text in the name, value, title or description.

exact.description: Require exact, case-insensitive name, description and value matches.

state.description: State filters, each TOKEN or TOKEN=true|false.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Read one property of an element.

ref.description: The element's qualified ref from a snapshot, as printed: @<snapshot_id>:e<N>.

tools.description: Check one state of an element.

ref.description: The element's qualified ref from a snapshot, as printed: @<snapshot_id>:e<N>.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a PNG screenshot of an app's window.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the running apps.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List the open windows, with the window IDs other tools take.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element through its accessibility press action.

ref.description: The element's qualified ref from a snapshot, as printed: @<snapshot_id>:e<N>.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the ref to resolve, in milliseconds (default 5000).

wait_for.description: After the action, poll until an element matching role:text appears, then return its snapshot.

wait_for_gone.description: After the action, poll until no element matches role:text.

tools.description: Launch an app, or attach to the running one.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Pause, or block until an element, window, text or menu appears.

element.description: Block until this element ref appears.

window.description: Block until a window with this title appears.

text.description: Block until this text appears in the app's tree.

menu.description: Block until a menu is open.

menu_closed.description: Block until the menu is dismissed.

app.description: Scope the wait to this app.
